### workspace promote --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace promote [BRANCH] [--name PROJECT] [--title TEXT] [--spine[=TEMPLATE] | --no-spine] [--plan[=TITLE]]
                         [--carry-note FILE]... [--launch [--prompt TEXT] [--prompt-timeout DURATION]]
                         [--agent-kind KIND] [--[no-]headless] [--force] [--dry-run] [--json]

Move the work in a main checkout into a new workspace: the staged, unstaged and untracked changes, and
the commits of the branch it is on, go to a worktree at .worktrees/BRANCH; the main checkout is left
clean on the default branch. Ignored files stay behind. The plan (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md) and spine/
move to the new notes directory (the old ones are renamed .moved-<time>), and each --carry-note is copied.
BRANCH omitted moves the current branch; on the default branch, name a new one (made at HEAD).
Nothing is launched unless --launch: seed the new workspace first, as the promote pack says
(workspace instructions compose --pack promote).

        --name PROJECT               The main checkout's workspace, from any directory (default: the working directory, which
                                     must be the top of a main checkout)
        --title TEXT                 The new workspace's task title
        --spine=[TEMPLATE]           Make the spine (spine init) when none was carried; TEMPLATE as for start --spine
        --no-spine                   Make no spine, even when spine.auto is true
        --plan=[TITLE]               Make the plan (plan init) when none was carried
        --carry-note FILE            Copy a note (relative to the main notes directory) into the new one; repeatable;
                                     never over a file that is there
        --launch                     Launch the new workspace once it is made: with a plan, as plan start does; else with --prompt
        --prompt TEXT                With --launch: text for the agent's first prompt
        --prompt-timeout DURATION    With --launch: how long to wait for the agent (default 60s)
        --agent-kind KIND            The new workspace's main agent: claude, codex, opencode, pi
        --[no-]headless              With --launch: start the session in plain tmux (see workspace launch --help)
        --force                      Move even while an agent pane of the main checkout works or waits (the caller's own
                                     pane, $TMUX_PANE, never counts)
        --dry-run                    Say what would move and write nothing; on the default branch BRANCH may be left out
        --json                       Print one JSON document; other output goes to stderr
    -h, --help                       Show this help

A failure part way is undone (move_failed); if undoing fails too, the changes are kept under
refs/workspace/promote/<id> and the error lists the git commands that get them back (move_incomplete).
Allow 60s without --launch, and --prompt-timeout plus 60s with it.

Examples:
  workspace promote    # on a feature branch: move its commits and the checkout's changes into a new worktree workspace
  workspace promote fix-login --dry-run    # on the default branch: say what would move to a new branch fix-login, write nothing
  workspace promote fix-login --dry-run --json    # the same, as one JSON document
  workspace promote fix-login --title "Fix the login bug" --spine --plan --carry-note research-login.md --json    # move it, make a spine and plan, copy one note, scripted
  workspace promote --name api --launch    # move the branch the "api" checkout is on, from any directory, then launch the new workspace
--- stderr
--- end

--- end

### workspace promote
